blind.B1: Yes. The exercise factor is the 8-week treadmill training in generation-15 male HRT/LRT rats: trained HRTT/LRTT vs untrained HRT/LRT, n=3 each, separate animals (S2.1.3.p1). The 6 HCR/LCR libraries belong to the capacity case.
blind.B2: HRTT vs LRTT (post-training line difference): 255 DEGs, 68 up in HRTT, 187 down (FC > 1.5, FDR < 0.05; S3.2.p1, Fig 2C). Each trained group vs its own untrained group (S3.2.p3, Supp Fig 2G), n=3 vs 3; text gives no counts for these, only n=193 unique low-response genes. HRT vs LRT untrained baseline is used in the human comparison (Fig 4).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: S2.1.3.p1 says a separate group of rats acted as untrained baseline, trained rats are different animals; one gastrocnemius each. Suffix 1-3 in titles is a replicate index.
blind.B4: Paper does not say; it only states Cuffdiff on all comparisons (S2.3.1.p1).
blind.B5: S3.2.p1: 'fold change > 1.5, FDR < 0.05'. S2.5.p1: p < 0.05 two-sided adjusted by Benjamini-Hochberg from Cuffdiff output. Counts: 255 (68 up HRTT / 187 down) for HRTT vs LRTT; no text counts for the within-line training contrasts.

checks.evidence: Real training arm; primary contrasts are the within-line training effects, line contrasts labelled associational secondary.
grp HRT/HRTT/LRT/LRTT each n=3 (GSM4697801-812), derived from description, matching S2.1.3.p1. The 6 HCR/LCR samples are excluded with a named reason.
LRTT vs LRT, HRTT vs HRT (trained over untrained), HRTT vs LRTT (68 up in HRTT, as S3.2.p1); paper-named genes Sln, Adcy1, Kcna10, Lgi3 up in HRTT agree.
S2.1.3.p1 separate animals; pairing_key_candidate is a replicate index and the expression check says not_supported (r 0.153 vs -0.075, p 0.08).
One joint model on 12 samples (~ cell). The paper is silent (B4) and applied counts differ a lot from the paper (8 vs 255, 2 vs 90), but only the joint fit is reported.
checks.fix: Optionally add pairwise two-group fits (LRTT vs LRT, HRTT vs HRT, HRTT vs LRTT) as a sensitivity run next to the joint fit.

checks.evidence: Packet B covariance gate: lane separates the two arms of every contrast (HRT L2 / HRTT L3 / LRTT L2 / LRT L1,L1,L3). It is recorded and carried as a study caveat, with lane-DEG log2FC correlating at r=0.59/0.41/-0.47/-0.17, but the gate status is 'not_required' while its own reasoning says a strict reading would stop the case. Lane is a flow-cell lane of one GATC run with consecutive library IDs, not a prep batch.

Raw counts with DESeq2 is the right route. pvalues_piled_near_1 flag: frac_p>0.9 is 0.15-0.20 in all four tables (median count 1 across 32,882 features), most likely low-count genes rather than a normalisation fault; frac_p<0.05 is only 0.02-0.06.

Rule transcribed correctly (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.5849625, strict). The mechanical flag shows DESeq2 pvalue<0.01 giving 257 (HRTT vs LRTT, paper 255) and 85 (HRTT vs HRT, deposited list 90). The ownership check shows the authors' Cuffdiff lists reproduce the counts under the stated rule, so the DESeq2 match is likely coincidence, but it is not written in the discrepancy list.
checks.fix: Add one line to the recorded discrepancies that pvalue<0.01 on DESeq2 coincides with the paper counts and was not used.

checks.evidence: HANDBACK table pairs each contrast with the same-contrast count and marks which counts come from the deposited Cuffdiff lists rather than the text; 8 vs 255 is shown as a gap, not as a match.
No stop recorded; the HRTT vs HRT ORA failure ('only 2 valid genes') is true and stated.

human_items: Lane is completely disjoint between arms in all four training contrasts; the case was kept as primary with a caveat instead of stopped, and the covariance gate says 'not_required'. Decide whether single-run lane aliasing needs a stop or only a label.
Paper is silent on joint vs pairwise fits and the applied counts are far below the paper's; decide whether a pairwise sensitivity fit should be added.
summary: 训练案例的分组（每组 3 只独立动物）、对比方向、无重复测量和阈值转录均与论文一致，没有阻断或重要错误。需要人工决定两个开放问题：测序泳道（lane）在每个对比中都与分组完全分离，目前仅作为警示保留；论文未说明联合或两两建模，而联合模型的 DEG 数（8、2）远低于论文的 255、90。另有 p 值在 1 附近堆积的提示和 pvalue<0.01 巧合接近论文数字的说明，均属次要。
